cloudOff.name: thread_deny
cloudOff.description: Answers the prompt the thread is stopped on and refuses the call, by thread id or a prefix of it. A thread stopped on a prompt reads Needs you in threads and runs nothing until somebody picks, so this is how a thread you did not open is unstuck; the prompt itself is on the thread's own rows, which thread_read prints. Refused in one line when the thread is waiting on no prompt and when the prompt it is stopped on carries no such answer, which is what a call that asks the person something rather than for consent does.

thread.description: the thread's id, or a prefix of it that names one, as threads lists them
